_about: Where a school's files live in Supabase Storage. Read by BOTH the data export (src/config/storagePrefixes.ts) and the deletion script (scripts/delete-school-data.js), so a path is exported and deleted together or neither. storagePrefixes.test.ts fails if an upload in src writes outside these. {schoolId} is the school's id; bucket "assets" means SUPABASE_STORAGE_BUCKET, default school-assets.
